description: A startup script for a React project that detects CI environments and redirects to static build serve to prevent process termination during CI runs, or starts the development server locally. It manages environment variables and chooses between static serving or development mode based on environment detection.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Determines if the current environment is a Continuous Integration environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with provided arguments, inheriting stdio and environment variables, then exits process with the same status.
